title: Run bootstrap allocates on the caller's heap while step-time growth uses the run arena — mixed ownership since the 6b84abc fix; initial buffers leak per run and run_destroy is dead
evidence:
core/run.odin run_init_bare:
	state.allocator = allocator
	// NOTE: never assigns context.allocator — the core must not mutate the
	// caller's context (allocator mixing = heap aborts; r1 lesson)
...
	topology := Topology{
		node_by_id = make(map[u32]u32),
		pipe_by_id = make(map[u32]u32),
...
	state.topology = topology
	flow_init(&state.flow, cat)

app/run/run.odin run_context_create:
	rc.heap = context.allocator
	rc.arena_buf = make([]u8, ARENA_SIZE)
	mem.arena_init(&rc.arena, rc.arena_buf)
	alloc := mem.arena_allocator(&rc.arena)
	rc.state = new(pp.Run_State, alloc)
	pp.run_init(rc.state, seed, catalogs, alloc)

core/run.odin step:
	prev_allocator := context.allocator
	context.allocator = state.allocator
	defer { context.allocator = prev_allocator }

core/run.odin (never called anywhere):
run_destroy :: proc(state: ^Run_State) {
	delete(state.topology.node_by_id)
	delete(state.topology.pipe_by_id)
}

core/mem/allocators.odin (Odin dev-2026-08, arena allocator):
	case .Free:
		return nil, .Mode_Not_Implemented
detail: 6b84abc removed `context.allocator = allocator` from run_init_bare; bootstrap maps/arrays now land on the caller's heap, step-time growth on the arena. Arena Free is Mode_Not_Implemented, so first-growth migration leaks the heap buffers; run_destroy (map cleanup) is never called.
recommended_fix: Save/restore context.allocator = allocator at the top of run_init_bare (matching flow_init/catalogs_load) so bootstrap lands on the run arena; have run_context_destroy call pp.run_destroy with the arena allocator.

title: snapshot_write re-clones the inventory tray slices onto the heap every frame; prior clones are never freed — per-frame heap churn that leaks for the run's lifetime (ODN-18)
detail: resnapshot runs every frame and per edit; each call heap-clones the tray slices and drops the prior clone unreferenced. ~60 B/frame leaks for the run's lifetime — ODN-18's 'zero per-frame heap churn' is broken in the new inventory snapshot path.
recommended_fix: Keep the tray snapshot as [dynamic]i32 reused with clear+append (like snap.nodes), or store fixed-size counts on Snapshot — no per-frame clone.

title: Demo autopilot policy ships inside package core (testkit.odin) and is linked into the game binary; '(NOT used by the game)' comment is stale; it is a second action-log writer beside the Command_Bus (ODN-12/§10.3)
detail: Policy (port-reserve min_free=2, best_router_in_stock, place_near relay chains) lives in core/testkit.odin, which ships in the game binary (--soak, 'A' key). It duplicates bus_submit's validate+log path, a second action-log writer beside the Command_Bus; the '(NOT used by the game)' header is stale.
recommended_fix: Move the autopilot (or at least the port-reserve/relay policy) to app/run/ or harness/ and submit through bus_submit; fix the '(NOT used by the game)' comment.

title: Catalog load iterates json.Object maps in core — literal ODN-10 violation ('the core does not iterate maps at all'); load-time and order-insensitive, so no determinism impact
detail: json.Object is a map; the new inventory parsing iterates it in core, violating ODN-10 ('the core does not iterate maps at all'). Load-time and order-insensitive use — no determinism impact, but the letter of the rule is broken.
recommended_fix: Resolve named inventory entries into arrays ordered by catalog index (or iterate the JSON in file order) — deterministic by construction, no map iteration in core.

title: ODN-18 tick arena not implemented: per-tick scratch rides context.temp_allocator, reset per frame in the app but only per demo in the harness (~24 MB+ across surge_basics' 5900 ticks)
evidence:
core/run.odin:
	plan := scripted_plan_pressure(state.catalogs, tick, context.temp_allocator)

core/flow.odin:
	arrived := make([dynamic]int, 0, 64, context.temp_allocator) // tiny; tick arena

harness/main.odin:
			append(&hashes, pp.state_hash(rc.state, rc.state.events[:], context.temp_allocator))
...
	for name in names {
		ok := run_demo(name, verb == "save")
		if !ok { failures += 1 }
		free_all(context.temp_allocator)
	}

app/main.odin:
		free_all(context.temp_allocator) // frame arena discipline (ODN-18)
detail: ODN-18 prescribes a tick arena reset per core.step; the plan, arrival scratch, and the 4 KB T1 writer buffer ride context.temp_allocator — reset per frame in the app, only per demo in the harness (surge_basics: ~24 MB+ across 5900 ticks).
recommended_fix: Reset context.temp_allocator at the top of the harness tick loop (per tick-frame), or give core.step an owned scratch arena reset at entry per ODN-18.
